band.window_note: all longitudes, so the band goes once around the Moon

resolution_note: pixel size at the equator; 4 pixels per degree
statistics_method: pixels with data only; median and percentiles by numpy (linear interpolation); rounded to 0.01 K

observed_range_K.label: observed range across both maps, not a daily swing

caveats: Local-time drift: the labels say LRO's orbit gives 'a drift in local time across each map', and the files do not store each pixel's local time. Daytime values are somewhere between 06:00 and 18:00 local time and nighttime values somewhere between 18:00 and 06:00, not at noon or midnight.
Different months: the daytime map covers 2010-01-21 to 2010-02-17 and the nighttime map covers 2010-01-07 to 2010-02-03 (UTC). They overlap but are not the same period.
7.6 km pixels: each pixel is 7580.8 m across at the equator (4 pixels per degree).
Empty pixels: many pixels have no data (-32768). Statistics use only pixels with data; the share of pixels with data is reported for each map.
Observed range is not a daily swing: day p95 minus night p5 compares two different groups of pixels, seen at different local times in different months.
